identity.title: Software is an instrument.
identity.subtitle: Every language, schema and abstraction is chosen for its measurable contribution to an objective — never by habit or taste.

principles.title: Instrumental rationality
principles.body: Means are evaluated against ends. What does not move the objective is removed.

principles.title: Engineering before ornament
principles.body: Specify, measure, then build. Form is a consequence of constraints.

principles.title: Data as ground truth
principles.body: Decisions are traced back to data. A model is only as reliable as its inputs.

principles.title: Flat control flow
principles.body: Many small functions, at most two levels of nesting, explicit contracts between them.

identity.outside: I train three times a week, with weighted calisthenics and barbell lifts, and I play acoustic guitar.

timeline.title: Multi-thread execution
timeline.subtitle: Three concurrent processes sharing one clock. None blocks the others.

projects.title: Systems & architecture
projects.subtitle: Projects built as bridges toward Data Engineering.

yourfinance.summary: Multi-user personal finance platform: a layered Rust workspace (pure domain, SQLx data layer, Axum API, background worker) over PostgreSQL, serving an Expo app for iOS, Android and web plus a Tauri desktop shell.
yourfinance.bridge: Integrity enforced in the database: balances maintained only by triggers, row-level security per user, SQL analytics functions for trends and budgets, idempotent imports of third-party exports.
highlights: Hexagonal crate split: an I/O-free domain checked in CI
Row-level security scoped on every pooled connection
Transactional outbox for push notifications, SKIP LOCKED job claims
Rotating refresh tokens, rate-limited login, typed error codes
Prometheus metrics, OTLP traces, health probes, graceful shutdown
Playwright E2E on the real stack, k6 load tests, compile-time checked SQL

ariaer.summary: End-to-end data platform for Emilia-Romagna air quality on ARPAE open data, enriched with Open-Meteo weather: Rust ingestion into partitioned Parquet, dbt models on DuckDB locally and BigQuery on GCP, Dagster orchestration. It runs locally with Docker, dashboard and CI included, and the same models ran on BigQuery in a real Google Cloud project with results identical to DuckDB.
ariaer.bridge: A pure data engineering project: provisional measurements revised after validation, gaps and inconsistent formats in the source, turned into a historized, tested dataset that answers legal-limit exceedances, pollutant trends and weather correlation.
highlights: Idempotent incremental ingestion: rolling-window reprocessing and upserts on the natural key
Layered dbt models (staging, intermediate, marts) with SCD Type 2 station history
Data quality as code: uniqueness, completeness and freshness tests
Completeness measured against an expected time grid, never filled in raw
Legal limits in a dbt seed, never hardcoded
Same models on DuckDB and BigQuery, infrastructure via Terraform
